subject: subject_01
gesture_instruction: Perform the specific intended finger action for this direction. Natural hand tilt may accompany it, but the finger action defines the gesture.
tilt_control_instruction: Keep your fingers relaxed and do only a comfortable wrist/hand tilt toward the prompted direction. Do not perform the intended gesture.
placement_instruction: Keep the band fixed during this session. Remove and re-wear it before a new session. Do not force any movement or use a painful range.
session_role: Development capture; not an independent final test.
notes: Gesture trials are labeled down, left, right, or top.
Tilt-only control trials are labeled rest/no-command and retain control_direction metadata.
Trials are randomized together; relax between every cue.
Preserve the local continuous source, raw BLE notification bytes, and sample-indexed cue sidecar.
Assign a unique acquisition_id before each recording; keep participant and recording paths in local ignored metadata.
A separate re-wear session is needed for cross-session evaluation. Reserve the final session until the model and settings are frozen.
